description: From the Kanoni overlook, the white Vlacherna monastery sits on a tiny islet at the end of a narrow causeway, and Pontikonisi, covered in dark cypresses, lies farther out in the bay. The morning is clear, about 20.8°C. The Old Fortress, Achilleion, Paleokastritsa, the Liston, and Canal d'Amour are not in the frame.
